summary.text: Ronnie A. Sabb is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 32, which covers Berkeley, Charleston, Florence, Georgetown, Horry and Williamsburg Counties.
He is an attorney and previously served in the S.C. House from 2011 to 2014.

paragraphs.text: Sabb was born on September 2, 1958, in Greeleyville, and his official page lists a B.S. from Voorhees College in 1980.
He served as an assistant solicitor from 1990 to 2010 and has been general counsel for Santee Electric Cooperative since 1997.
He served on the South Carolina Bar Board of Governors from 2007 to 2010 and in the S.C. House from 2011 to 2014.
His Senate committees are Education, Ethics, Finance, Legislative Oversight, Medical Affairs and Rules.
